sections.text:
Ability Power 180. Damages all enemies with physical fire damage that ignores DEF.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Reduces ATK and MATK of all enemies by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Casts 30% concentration on your character for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 4000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 4000
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 180-Ability-Power attack that ignores DEF and deals physical fire damage to all enemies by 100.
[Additional Unison Effect] Reduces the status ailment resistance of all enemies by 50% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Reduces DEF and MDEF of all enemies by 50% for 60 seconds.
Only [CC] Nyx x Tenth Angel can be used as Unlocking Potential material
